notes.title: The final version of Villa No. 1 is here!
notes.notes:
After more than a month of internal and external testing, Villa 1 has finally reached the time to meet with players. During this period, based on feedback from players, we have fixed the following issues

1. The problem of process disorder during the pursuit period

2. The problem of chasing for too long

3. The problem of misunderstandings caused by TipsMessage

4. The multitude of multilingual issues

5. Numerous optimization points in the process



The final version has finally arrived and is expected to be released next

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Steam New Product Festival Feedback Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216198/9a580c487228a02a80778a8a256efb604a82854c.png
Hello everyone, we are the TakeTalk development team
During the New Product Festival, hundreds of enthusiastic players tried our game, and we feel very lucky. 

We are also grateful for the many feedbacks provided by our enthusiastic friends, including but not limited to
1. The UI selection suddenly disappears
2. When the UI is opened, movement can also be operated
3. The decryption of the electrical box in the 1st floor distribution room can be repeated
4. Unknown archive issue
wait

We have also made a series of updates to address the above issues. We hope that interested players can download the latest version of the trial version of "Villa 1" to experience it!
Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: The beta version of 'Villa 1' has been released
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216198/58242632d46403a2333e7b9356ff404eedc81a9f.png

After a period of development, testing, and feedback, our beta version has finally been officially released. Our next goal is the New Product Festival in October 2024. We hope everyone can pay attention and provide valuable feedback!
